text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond tries to make herself stronger, but it disrupts her form and her times drop. There's not much time left till her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to go back to running how she used to, but it doesn't seem to help. She realizes that she's losing her running style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I talk it over with Kitasan Black, and she agrees to run with Satono Diamond. However, Satono still can't get back to running the way she used to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After their training, Kitasan Black suddenly takes Satono Diamond's hand and runs off with her. The two of them run to many different places.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond remembers how it felt when she used to run single-mindedly after Kitasan Black. Before she knows it, she's back to running like her old self again.
